description: The bar chart illustrates the performance gain (%) of different models under two supervision conditions: Strong Supervision and Weak Supervision, as evaluated in the context of the VisuoThink paper. The horizontal axis displays three models: GPT-4o, Claude-3.5-Sonnet, and Qwen2-72B-VL. The vertical axis represents the performance gain in percentage, ranging from 0 to 30. For each model, two bars are shown: a striped bar for Strong Supervision and a solid bar for Weak Supervision. GPT-4o shows the highest performance gain under Strong Supervision, at approximately 25%, with a much lower gain of about 5% under Weak Supervision. Claude-3.5-Sonnet has a performance gain of around 10% under Strong Supervision and about 4% under Weak Supervision. Qwen2-72B-VL demonstrates a performance gain of approximately 15% under Strong Supervision and about 5% under Weak Supervision. In all cases, the performance gain is significantly higher under Strong Supervision compared to Weak Supervision.
